text:
Alex: heads up — noticed a customer on mobile is triggering a reconnect storm after phone sleep. Console shows hundreds of very short sessions 1-5s, routing flips, and double billing. Anyone seen this pattern before?
Jordan: yup. sounds like timer drift + resume token churn. client OS sleeps -> local clock shifts -> client fires reconnects that look new to our router. :thinking:
Maya: telemetry gap: we don't capture client-side monotonic ts in the resume telemetry so we can't distinguish real new sessions vs drifted resumes. console just shows different route_id each time.
Sam: is the resume token expiring too quickly? or are we invalidating KV cache on disconnect?
Jordan: not expiring. more like our session affinity key includes ip/conn-id that changes on mobile NAT churn. router then assigns different shard -> new billing.
Alex: customer report says 700 short connects in 10 mins, took them from free to charged quota spike. DevEx is getting inbound support tickets. :grimacing:
DevEx: can we do a quick mitigator that doesn't change billing semantics for everyone? maybe a grace window where reconnects within N seconds are not billed/are merged?
Maya: propose server-side heuristic: if resume_token seen within 5s of last seen for same user token, treat as same session for routing and billing. need telemetry to validate.
Sam: 5s ok but edge cases where legit new session comes in. What if a replay attack uses resume_token? security review needed.
sre-bot: alert: streaming_quota_spike cluster=us-west-2 count=732 window=10m severity=warning
Jordan: quick patch idea: add header X-Client-Monotonic (ms) populated by SDK. If present, router can use monotonic delta to detect sleep/resume instead of marking new. fallback to grace window if missing.
Alex: SDKs won't be immediate. we need a server-first mitigation and a roadmap for SDK + console.
Maya: action list: 1) immediate canary: extend resume window from 1s -> 5s in 10% of traffic (config flag), 2) emit "resume_detected" telemetry with route_id/prev_route_id and resume_delta, 3) add dashboard tile showing duplicate-session rate and billing delta.
DevEx: +1 on dashboard. need to show estimated refunded tokens and impacted customers. I'll draft a console widget mock.
Sam: security: add a rule: only auto-merge if resume_token signature valid and token_age < 1h. I'll write short PR for server check.
Jordan: logging snippet for router change: ```
if (resume_token && now - token_last_seen < GRACE_MS) {
  // merge session, keep same route_id, do not increment billing counter
} else {
  // allocate new shard and bill normally
}
```
Maya: we'll need migration telemetry: how many reconnects would have been merged. We'll run canary for 48h and review.
Alex: timeline?
Maya: canary config PR today, router rollout tomorrow, telemetry dashboard (read-only) by EOD tomorrow.
DevEx: I'll prep support message and a billing FAQ.
Alex: thanks. keeping this thread for post-mortem notes. please ping if you hit blockers. :eyes:
